description: Using Azure Data Studio, connect to the local SQL Server instance and write a SQL query against the AdventureWorks2022 database. Your task is to find the top 10 best-selling products by total quantity sold. Join the Sales.SalesOrderDetail table with Production.Product table to get product names. The CSV output should have columns named 'ProductName' and 'TotalQuantitySold'. Execute the query in Azure Data Studio and save the results to /home/ga/Documents/exports/top_products.csv using Azure Data Studio's export feature (right-click on results grid and select 'Save As CSV').
